title: sorghum bicolor var. transiens
intro: Sorghum bicolor var. transiens, commonly known as broom sorghum, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Poaceae family, characterized by its broad leaves and branching habit. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of broom sorghum are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hypoglycemic agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of broom sorghum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
